earnings.title: Dell Technologies Delivers Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Record revenue of $54.9 billion, up 103% year over year
Record diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $8.82, up 287% year over year, and record non-GAAP diluted EPS of $9.45, up 265%
Record third-quarter cash flow from operations of $4.5 billion
Record revenue: $42.0 billion, up 198% year over year
Record AI-Optimized Servers revenue: $22.0 billion, up 291% year over year

quotes.text: We expect record full-year revenue of $202 billion , up 78%. We are now a different company, with Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) driving the vast majority of our profit and growth .
quotes.by: Jeff Clarke, vice chairman and chief operating officer, Dell Technologies

quotes.text: The team executed exceptionally well, driving record revenue of $54.9 billion, record EPS and a record $4.9 billion returned to shareholders .
quotes.by: David Kennedy, chief financial officer, Dell Technologies

outlook: Full-year FY27 revenue guidance of $202.0 billion, up 78% year over year
Full-year FY27 diluted EPS guidance of $28.24 and non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $29.68, up 225% and 188% year over year, respectively
